#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore(); // ignore the newline after the integer input
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    // Split string s by parentheses using a simple approach
    std::vector<std::string> p;
    std::string temp;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '(' || s[i] == ')') {
            if (!temp.empty()) {
                p.push_back(temp);
                temp.clear();
            }
        } else {
            temp += s[i];
        }
    }
    if (!temp.empty()) {
        p.push_back(temp);
    }

    int max_len = 0;
    for (const auto& segment : p) {
        std::stringstream ss(segment);
        std::string token;
        while (std::getline(ss, token, '_')) {
            if (token.length() > max_len) {
                max_len = token.length();
            }
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> li;
    int last = -1;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '(') {
            last = i;
        } else if (s[i] == ')' && last != -1) {
            li.push_back(s.substr(last + 1, i - last - 1));
        }
    }

    int count = 0;
    for (const auto& item : li) {
        std::stringstream ss(item);
        std::string word;
        while (std::getline(ss, word, '_')) {
            if (!word.empty()) {
                count++;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_len << " " << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
